desc: Ideation: select the first-entry subtraction approach as the primary algorithm.

Implement the complete Python solution using the first-entry subtraction approach, including factorial precomputation, binomial helpers, closed-form rectangle sums, inclusion-exclusion for outside start/end paths, first-entry invalid-path sums over bottom/left edges, and all boundary cases.
Validate the implementation against the provided samples and edge cases such as L=0, D=0, holes touching the grid boundary, and one-dimensional grids; fix any failures.
